'''Blake Roth Vaderless Inexpensive Killer Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Blake Roth]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Level 4 Military Corridor|Premiere-D-deathstarlevel4militarycorridor.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Vaderless Inexpensive Killer Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Vaderless Inexpensive Killer Deck.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This deck does not cost much at all. It is easy to win with once you have learned how to use it. I have only lost ONCE out of about 20 games (at least). Try it out and see how you like it.

== Strategy ==

Your starting site should be Death Star War Room. Use Elis Elrot and spies to move characters to sites where you do not generate any force and force drain your opponent. Use Kessel to deploy your star ships. Dantooine will allow you to build up your air until you have more power than your opponent (by reacting). Use Mosep on Tatooine to make the force drain come from the force pile which will hender your opponents number of cards to use as force. Play a few games that do not mean anything to see how it works. It may not look good on paper but it is great for playing.
